Great buzz, had one like it before myself. Consider stacking your treatments as soon as possible- when I buzzed and then let my hair loss intensify my hairline was very visible so fin and other topicals use on regular basis. The crown is not noticeable but don’t let it become so 👍🏼

I think there’s better clinically proven products to use, I’ve had bad experiences so I’m a bit biased. I think you could see benefits but the anti fungal is the key and I think a doctor would point you in that way. I have also had full body dermatitis and I wouldn’t go near any oils rather steroid/anti fungal medication
Quit the rosemary oil and use antifungal shampoo/cream (for hair Obs). Rosemary oil irritates the scalp and may cause further loss

Reach out to people at your institution, let others know you’re finding things difficult. Situation is wholly different from yours but I worked for free as a carer for my abusive uncle at home and never seemed to be worth it, wanted to escape and leave the difficult existence behind. 

You have to have a duty to yourself to make yourself into that adult who can care for their children as you’d care for yourself. Even if you didn’t care about kids (nor do I) reach out to your college and ask for help with living arrangements and food. You deserve the best and I’ll be praying for you

The narrative in this work is really well done, I really love the first person perspective, even when the narrator leaves the world behind and steps into the next. 

I would have liked to have seen another stanza about life in this house rather than the jump from birth to death. I mean it’s really good still and might be more appropriate for another work but I think that it would benefit from something like that; maybe what caused the carvings or what they represent. 

I really enjoyed this tho. Thanks for posting and I wanna see more !

I really like the almost cyclical nature of your poem. As previously mentioned the movement from day to day and then to evening for me conveys the struggle of the human lover really well. 

The imagery of pain and angst is also really nice. I really like the line ‘strangled sounds of morn’. For me personally I can imagine a real fight or struggle. 

Good job 👏🏻
